screening.rule: Each attack must pass both reference ratios in every dataset/partition. Excess ASR is paired attacked-minus-clean FedAvg ASR. All 20/40/60/80% results are retained. No best-round selection or post-hoc change of source/target/onset/scales.
screening.on_failure: Report all failed cells and hold defense tuning/formal comparison for that attack. Do not expand the attack search automatically.

scheduler.group_policy: All candidate/method tasks of a matched scenario sequential on one GPU, cyclic order.
scheduler.timing_caveat: Shared GPU wall time with load and concurrency recorded; not an exclusive hardware speed benchmark.

prior_test_exposure: The stopped unscreened study completed 46 official-test tasks. Those results are exploratory, excluded from this selection and from new formal aggregates. New seeds do not erase that prior exposure.
